# SEOzapp

> SEOzapp is an AI-search visibility platform that combines traditional technical SEO auditing with AEO/GEO (Answer Engine Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization). It tracks how brands are cited across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, audits 25+ on-page and technical SEO factors, benchmarks brands against competitors, audits AI crawler (bot) access, and surfaces brand mentions and backlinks — built primarily for solo and small SEO agencies.

Core capabilities:
- Technical SEO Tracking: continuous automated audits across 25+ ranking signals (DOM hierarchy, meta structure, indexability, heading flow), with historical score drift and anomaly alerts.
- Multi-LLM Prompt Monitoring: scheduled prompt runs across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews to measure citation frequency, rank/citation position, and response sentiment.
- Competitor Intelligence: side-by-side AI Readiness, structural health, topic coverage, and schema adoption benchmarking against rival domains.
- AI Citation & GEO: semantic scoring for answer clarity and passage quoteability, plus generation of standardized `/llms.txt` context manifests.
- AI Crawlability & Bot Access Audit: checks whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ByteSpider, and CCBot can access site content via robots.txt and meta tags.
- Brand Mention & Backlink Intelligence: discovers unlinked brand mentions, backlinks, and domain authority/sentiment signals, with outreach pitch templates.
